# Breeze Bookkeeping

> Professional bookkeeping services by Darren Cardwell. Serving small businesses nationwide across all 50 states with accurate, affordable, and stress-free accounting. Based in Herriman, UT.

## About

Breeze Bookkeeping is a professional bookkeeping firm founded by Darren Cardwell. Based in Herriman, Utah, near Salt Lake City, Breeze Bookkeeping serves business owners across the entire United States using secure, cloud-based technology. The tagline is "Effortless accounting that feels like a breeze."

Darren Cardwell is a professional bookkeeper with over 30 years of experience who specializes in making bookkeeping fast, accurate, and affordable. He integrates the best financial apps and accounting software to streamline clients' systems, saving them time and money.

## Services

Breeze Bookkeeping offers comprehensive bookkeeping and accounting services including:

- Monthly bookkeeping
- Bank and credit card transaction categorization
- Bank and credit card reconciliation
- Accounts receivable
- Accounts payable
- Payroll processing and tax filing
- Job costing
- Inventory tracking
- Fixed asset management
- Sales tax accounting and filing
- Financial reporting and analysis
- Management reporting
- 1099 filings
- Bookkeeping cleanups (catching up on behind bookkeeping)
- Accounting software consulting and setup

## Service Area

- Serves clients in all 50 states via secure, cloud-based technology
- No in-person meetings required — everything is handled remotely
- Headquartered in Herriman, UT (Salt Lake City metro area)
